note: I1 declaration: the single list of canonical system components. Builds COPY each canonical body verbatim into packages (I3); they never rewrite it. A gate byte-compares every copied body above its '## Team Context (editable)' marker against the file listed here. Canonical changes propagate by rebuild (I4). Per-agent domain assets (skills/knowledge/styles/data/scripts/benchmarks) are exempt (I5).

components.runtimeChokepoint: deterministic always-on curator (electron/memory/curator.ts) enforces G1-G5 every turn with no extra LLM call; this body is the explicit deep-curation layer
host PreToolUse hook - the only point that can actually refuse a tool call
host graph judge engine (judgeChecklist, EVAL_STUCK, separate-context judging, no self-grading)

components.notes: The orchestrator body stays team-authored; its header must declare compliance with this protocol. The protocol file itself is copied verbatim to docs/ so the reference resolves offline.

components.runtimeChokepoint: both runtime bundle emitters prepend the fenced directive to the entry (Agentlas-OS agentlas_cloud/runtime.py WORKER_MEMORY_DIRECTIVE, Hub runtime-bundle.ts WORKER_MEMORY_DIRECTIVE); scripts/sync-worker-memory-directive.sh byte-compares all three
components.notes: Never copied into packages. Recall reaches an agent through the host capsule, but emission is the agent's job, and an agent borrowed onto a host without the Agentlas hook was never told to emit - it left a request hash and lost the learning. Injecting from the emitter reaches every borrowed agent from one place instead of asking 178 packages to each carry the same text.

components.runtimeChokepoint: built-in agent agentlas-task-bias in agentlas_desktop electron/architecture/manifest.ts (TASK_BIAS_PROMPT); owns <project>/.agentlas/sitemap.json, whose skeleton lives in electron/memory/project-files.ts
components.notes: The fourth runtime built-in, alongside the meta-agent, PM Soul, and the Memory Curator. Not copied into packages: it governs a project folder, not an agent. It is the write owner of the sitemap memory root - the memory map must name it, not project bootstrap.
Read by builders and gates; never copied into packages.

runtimeOwned: context maps and code maps (project-level, not agent-level)
singlePackages: Single-agent packages copy none of these bodies. The deterministic runtime layers cover the functions: always-on curator every turn, Memory Ticket ledger, project soul log, host PreToolUse hook, host judge engine. See system-agents/folder-rules.md.
